display.purpose: Literata 600 with optical sizing for the personal name on the notebook opening page.

label.purpose: Short mono metadata at readable sizes.

diagram-annotation.purpose: JetBrains Mono 500 at 22 SVG user units (about 10–11px rendered at current card widths), confined to aria-hidden project drawings. Never used for readable UI labels.

toolkit-title.purpose: Caveat 600 handwriting shared by approach and toolkit note headings and the contact location note.

shadows.name: sticky
shadows.purpose: Approach sticky notes: the adhesive top lies flat and only the bottom edge lifts.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Small material shadow under decorative tape.

motion.name: intro
motion.value: 400ms ease-out; opacity and translateY(6px) to rest
motion.purpose: One initial introduction; disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Button color changes; disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: highlighter-arrival
motion.value: 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) after 450ms; scaleX(0) to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: Marks the heading of a section reached by link once the scroll lands; fades in over 200ms with reduced motion.

motion.name: nav-highlight
motion.value: 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); scaleX(0) to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: Moves the you-are-here marker to the section being read; appears without a sweep with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in the current section.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0.7rem 1.1rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; background:var(--accent, #087166); color:#fff; font:600 15.2px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--accent-strong, #075b53); } .ds-button:active { background:var(--accent-strong, #075b53);color:#fff; } .ds-button:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--accent, #087166);outline-offset:4px;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0.7rem 1.1rem; border:1px solid var(--border-strong, #b8ae9f); border-radius:9px; background:var(--surface, #fffdf8); color:var(--text, #101820); font:600 15.2px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--accent-soft, #e5efe8); } .ds-button:active { background:var(--accent-strong, #075b53);color:#fff; } .ds-button:focus-visible {outline:3px solid var(--accent, #087166);outline-offset:4px;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;}}

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: A quiet surface for career evidence.
components.css: .ds-paper{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--border,#ddd5c7);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#fffdf8);color:var(--text,#101820);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgb(58 47 29 / 4%),0 8px 18px rgb(58 47 29 / 4%);font:16px/1.65 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-paper h3{margin:0;font:600 24px/1.15 Literata,Georgia,serif}.ds-paper p{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--text-muted,#45525a)}

components.name: Sticky Note
components.description: Untaped sticky notes for working principles: the adhesive top lies flat and only the bottom edge lifts.
components.html:
Build for the long term

Accessibility and reusable patterns belong in the foundation.
components.css: .ds-note{position:relative;padding:24px;border:1px solid #dcc57d;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(var(--note,#f3dda0) 60%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--note,#f3dda0),#dcc57d 35%));box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(79 61 24 / 8%),0 16px 14px -12px rgb(79 61 24 / 30%);color:var(--text,#101820);font:16px/1.6 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-note h3{margin:0;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #dcc57d;font:600 28px/1.3 Caveat,"Segoe Print",cursive}.ds-note p{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--text-muted,#45525a)}

components.name: Graph Paper
components.description: A restrained ground for diagrams and contact.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Compact paper navigation with a clear résumé path, a blueprint theme toggle, and a highlighter marking the section being read.
components.html: BWExperienceWorkRésumé
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:var(--bg,#f7f3ea);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#ddd5c7);font:600 14px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;color:var(--text,#101820);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav .ds-brand{border:1px solid var(--text,#101820);background:var(--surface,#fffdf8);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--accent,#087166)}.ds-nav .ds-resume{background:var(--accent,#087166);color:#fff;border-radius:9px}.ds-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#087166);outline-offset:4px}.ds-nav a[aria-current] span{position:relative;z-index:0}.ds-nav a[aria-current] span::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;left:-.3em;right:-.3em;bottom:.2em;height:.68em;border-radius:.12em .3em .18em .35em;background:#f7dc6f;transform:rotate(-1deg)}.ds-toggle{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid #b8ae9f;border-radius:8px;background:#fffdf8;color:#101820;font-size:18px}

components.name: Toolkit Note
components.description: White notes with handwritten headings and medium-weight ink lists; side-by-side notes match the tallest content, stacked notes fit their own.
components.css: .ds-toolkit{position:relative;padding:24px;border:1px solid #ddd5c7;border-radius:3px;background:#fffdf8;color:#101820;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgb(58 47 29 / 4%),0 8px 18px rgb(58 47 29 / 4%)}.ds-toolkit h3{margin:0;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd5c7;font:600 28px/1.3 Caveat,"Segoe Print",cursive}.ds-toolkit p{margin:20px 0 8px;font:500 12px/1.6 "JetBrains Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#526168}.ds-toolkit ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;font:500 16px/1.65 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}

components.name: Contact Entry
components.description: Dark-ink email on the graph ruling with a Copy button beside it and a handwritten hint below; the underline follows each wrapped line.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-contact{--grid:1.5rem;padding:var(--grid);background-color:#fbfaf4;background-image:linear-gradient(rgb(8 113 102 / 8%) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(8 113 102 / 8%) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:var(--grid) var(--grid);font-family:"IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-email-line{position:relative;top:.25rem;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600;line-height:var(--grid);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-email{padding-block:.625rem;color:#101820;text-decoration:none}.ds-email strong{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:0}.ds-copy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:44px;margin:-10px 0 -10px .35rem;padding:0 .4rem;vertical-align:top;border:0;background:none;color:#087166;font:600 .875rem/1 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-hint{display:inline-block;margin:.5rem 0 .25rem 3.5rem;transform:rotate(-3deg);font:600 1.375rem/1 Caveat,"Segoe Print",cursive;color:#087166}.ds-resume{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;margin-top:8px;color:#087166;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;text-underline-offset:.22em}.ds-contact a:hover,.ds-contact a:active,.ds-copy:hover{color:#075b53}.ds-contact :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #087166;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:4px}

narrative.overview: A professional engineer’s notebook: warm paper, dark ink, restrained teal, and a few taped notes. The material details give the portfolio a recognizable identity while the typography and spacing keep career evidence easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and subtle graph lines
Selective tape and soft paper shadows
dos: Do preserve the notebook, graph-paper, and tape identity.
Do keep useful body copy at 1rem and supporting labels at least 0.75rem.
Do let content reflow at narrow widths and enlarged text sizes.
Do keep focus visible and standalone controls at least 44px in both dimensions.
donts: Don’t add hover movement to passive cards, statistics, or illustrations.
Don’t hide sections behind scroll-reveal observers.
Don’t shrink or truncate important content to force it into a fixed layout.
Don’t replace intentionally unfinished projects with invented case studies.
Don’t tape every card. Tape on everything stops meaning anything, and sticky notes stick on their own.
Don’t put a yellow highlighter on blueprint blue; it turns olive.
Don’t hard-code a color that differs between themes; give it a light-dark() token.
